Yamy is an open, independent app. To talk and practice without intermediaries or subscriptions, it connects directly to Gemini models using your personal Google AI Studio API key.
1. Sign in to Google AI Studio with your Google account.\n2. Tap \"Get API key\" or \"Create API key\".\n3. Copy your generated key.
Tap Settings (gear icon in the top right), open \"Advanced > Personal API key\" and paste your key to start practicing.
